classification_reason: The determinism report is byte-identical: 20 derived files, raw and timestamp-normalized comparison both identical after deleting generated/ and the diagnostic store and rebuilding. Extra abuse beyond the procedure found one contrived crash (F-s07-05) and a dirty tracked file after 'delete generated freely'. Neither affects the scenario's determinism question.

consumer.goal: Run the determinism check on a fresh world, then probe how the product reacts to deleted or corrupted derived state
commands: replace generated/manifest.json with a directory → same 7 reads; los generate; make views
consumer.outcome: Derived state rebuilds identically. CLI reads never depend on generated/. Truncated manifest → validate ERROR GEN-JSON (blocks commit until make views); deleted generated/ → HYGIENE-VIEWS warning; a directory in place of the manifest → generate/status/validate crash.

internal.projection_activity: two full builds inside the determinism copy; make views ×4 in the world
internal.derived_changes: world generated/ populated (19 files added relative to the fresh build)
unexpected_writes: rm -rf generated/ + make views leaves tracked generated/.gitkeep deleted (' D generated/.gitkeep'); the pre-push gate requires a clean worktree
warnings_errors: truncated manifest: E GEN-JSON generated JSON does not parse [generated/manifest.json] (validate exit 1; status 'validation: 1 error(s)')
deleted generated/: W HYGIENE-VIEWS views absent
manifest as directory: IsADirectoryError tracebacks in generate/status/validate

friction.description: raw Python traceback from generate/validate/status when the manifest path is a directory
deleting generated/ as the README allows removes the tracked generated/.gitkeep, which make views does not restore

extra_probes.truncated_manifest: CLI reads unaffected (they project from canonical files); validate ERROR GEN-JSON + HYGIENE-VIEWS; status reports 1 error; make views repairs
extra_probes.deleted_generated: CLI reads unaffected; validate W HYGIENE-VIEWS; make views repairs but leaves generated/.gitkeep deleted
extra_probes.manifest_is_directory: search/inspect/bootstrap/related/intelligence-scan OK; status, validate, generate, make views crash (IsADirectoryError)
